title: Effect name aliases
name: effect names
def: Script (not ScriptRun), SessionWrite (not AppStateWrite), Process (not Spawn), Capture (not MediaCapture) are the Effect names

title: Evidence marks
def: Source (read in code), measured, cited, estimate. Branch plugin-beta at 02064025; paths relative to the effectcraft repo.

title: Op name style
name: op name
def: Op names are lowerCamel dotted (job.runCommand, os.openUrl); permission names are a separate namespace (ui.open_url is the permission for os.openUrl)

title: below-stack key
name: below-stack key
def: Cache key for an adjustment layer: content keys, order, blending modes and track mattes of every layer below.

title: durable frames
name: durable frames
def: EXR frames of a layer after its last plugin effect, written by final renders, used when the plugin is missing.

title: instance pool
name: instance pool
def: One worker per package version holds a pool of effect instances sized by committed bytes (CON instance-pool@1).

title: preview fill
name: preview fill
def: Preview > Play renders the work area at full quality under PreviewFill, then plays from cache.

title: Scope word all
def: Every open project; EffectCraft has one session project, kept for parity.

title: Scope word instance
def: Implicit, free, not a permission spelling: one effect instance's own parameters, instance-scoped data and its layer's data for this plugin; supervise events, buttons and designer windows hold it without a prompt.

title: Scope word selection
def: Captured selection: project items, layers, properties, keyframes, effects and masks, captured as explicit ids at event start (today only layer ids, CAPTURED_SELECTION).

title: tainted expression
name: tainted expression
def: A plugin-written expression or one calling plugin-shipped lib() or fn() code; evaluated only in ext-expr and never by expr-boa.

title: durable output
name: durable
def: The stored result of a plugin job or render (image key, geometry, widget snapshot) kept on the node so the document renders and exports without the plugin.

title: Authorization
def: Value carrying origin, EffectMask, ScopeToken and FileAuthority, passed to Session::execute and every sink call and captured by value by every queued item.

title: Hardware gesture
def: An event whose Input is Input::Hardware: minted only by the platform input layer from OS-attested device input (no injected flag on Windows, source pid 0 and HID state on macOS, a non-XTEST, non-virtual XI2 device on X11, seat input on Wayland). Automation, MCP and web-window input is Automation.

title: Held
def: Plugin state when a required entry is unavailable because a switch is off; the plugin stays installed with grants and data and does not load.

title: Never-grantable list
def: The single list craft_command::Never N1..N7 of things no plugin can be granted, rendered by craft-ext docs never.

title: Stop all plugins
def: Host chord handled before any plugin that revokes every running plugin event, closes plugin modals and full-screen windows, unregisters hotkeys and kills input-monitor helpers until next launch.
